Two sisters built a coral reef... out of yarn!
In 2005, twin sisters in Los Angeles were worried about the Great Barrier Reef.
So they crocheted coral, with a maths trick. Add extra stitches every row, and it curls.
Then the world joined in. More than eight thousand crocheters made their own reefs.
Would you crochet a piece of the reef... or just admire it?
